EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by two very strong bands at 2234 cm⁻¹ (typical ν(C≡N) of an aromatic nitrile) and 1003 cm⁻¹ (intense benzene-ring breathing). Additional bands at 1605/1585 cm⁻¹ (aromatic C=C), 1382 cm⁻¹ (CH₃ deformation), 2930 cm⁻¹ (aliphatic CH stretch) and 3073 cm⁻¹ (aromatic CH stretch) indicate a methyl-substituted aromatic nitrile. The presence of medium bands near 713 cm⁻¹, 582 cm⁻¹ and 527 cm⁻¹ fits the characteristic C–H out-of-plane bending and ring deformations expected for a meta-disubstituted benzene, supporting 3-cyanotoluene (candidate 1, Cc1cccc(C#N)c1). Para-substitution (candidate 10) would give a strong C–H wag near 825 cm⁻¹, which is absent. Therefore candidate 1 provides the best match to the observed Raman peaks.
